blocks.text: Start with the path that matches your task:

| I want to… | Open |
|---|---|
| Try a portable handoff | [Five-minute demo](../examples/portable-handoff/) |
| Implement or verify the protocol | [Portable Artifact V1 contract](PORTABLE_ARTIFACT_SPEC.md) |
| Bind provenance to any artifact type | [Artifact Provenance Protocol](ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE_PROTOCOL.md) |
| Carry actionable handoff decisions | [Artifact Provenance Protocol — admitted decisions](ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE_PROTOCOL.md#41-admitted-decisions) |
| Turn bounded agent telemetry into governed context | [Verified Knowledge Ledger](VERIFIED_KNOWLEDGE_LEDGER.md) |
| Decide what may be disclosed | [Privacy Boundaries](PRIVACY_AND_DISCLOSURE.md) |
| Answer common trust and workflow questions | [FAQ](FAQ.md) |
| Connect an agent harness | [Agent adapters](../skills/) |

The zero-dependency [`proofpress.py`](../proofpress.py) CLI is the reference
implementation. Portable artifact and provenance documents are normative only
where they say so. The verified knowledge ledger is an implemented developer
wedge, not yet a frozen interchange specification.

Proofpress provides a checkable record, not signed authorship, complete
capture, or a universal truth oracle. Product strategy and experimental
efficacy claims remain outside the public protocol contract.
